description: Java class representing order total details in an e-commerce system, including fields for code, title, text, value, module, order value type, order total type, and associated order.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class for order total information, including annotations for ORM mapping and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order total.
